title: Web route fixtures (/api/v1, SPEC-CONTRACT-SERVER §4.2, SPEC-WEB-UX §4.3); RFC 3339 UTC times (S17)

totp_code.description: 6-digit TOTP or a recovery code like 3f9a-07bc

fixture.description: one file per web route: route id, method, concrete path, request body (or null), the success response and the error examples; bodies are validated against the route's own definitions by the gate

ids_var.description: ids and counts only, resolved at read time; a purged id renders as null (R35)

me_overview_response.description: GET /api/v1/me/overview (C line, the /app/ cockpit): every workspace of the signed-in person in one request; each part is the body of its per-workspace route (instances W96 state=all limit=200, enforcement W79, cockpit, pilot_metrics W95 for admins, billing for admins) or an error part.

insights.description: engine metrics v2 KPIs of the workspace (GET …/insights/summary), or an overview_part_error

overview_part_error.description: A part the person may not read, or that failed: the route's code and status.

w7o_response.description: W7o: the new owner and the caller's role now

w7d_request.description: W7d POST /api/v1/orgs/{o}/delete: the workspace's slug typed back

w14t_response.description: W14t GET …/vaults/{r}/nodes/titles?ids= (C line): the title and knowledge state of each known node id, in the order asked; unknown ids left out; title null once purged

vault_knowledge_states.description: The W24 knowledge_states, also on each vault of the vault list (C line)

w3_response.description: W3 GET /api/v1/orgs/{o}/logbook?place=&kind=&mine=&cursor= (one id per worker × place × kind × 15-min window, R88)

text_vars.description: only for own/workspace provenance, never for sealed places

next_cursor.description: opaque (R137): send it back unchanged as ?cursor=; pages run over (at, id) newest first, never over the random line id alone

w7_response.description: W7 GET /api/v1/orgs/{o}: the existing org fields plus the v4 members (required here); company = the company the team belongs to (API.md §2.5; `organisation` is its B-line name, kept), null for a personal workspace or a standalone team; plan_inherited = the plan in force is the company's Business plan

presence_public.description: W25 owner switch: presence of this vault's workers shown to people outside the workspace (public vaults)

sealed_grants.description: W25 owner switch: how a recipient engine answers a sealed_grant request

w11_request.description: W11 POST /api/v1/orgs/{o}/vaults/{r}/transfer (owner of both workspaces, human-only class H, 5 per user; R142, R143): vaults with 1.x content → 409 invalid_state reason legacy_content; sealed vaults → 409 invalid_state reason sealed_transfer_later (3.12.0); the target must not be the vault's workspace (409 invalid_state reason same_org) nor hold a vault of the same name (409 slug_taken); a Community target at its vault limit → 402 plan_required feature: repos; one transfer of a vault at a time (409 invalid_state reason transfer_running)

w11_response.description: W11 answer = the W9 v4 vault in its new workspace; a public vault's binding is unverified (read-only until verified again)

node_body.description: W12 body by Node.type (no type member inside the body): exactly the SPEC-WEB-UX §4.3 fields, plus anchors on fact/gotcha/procedure (lead addition)

web_worker.description: W33 Worker (and Worker in place contexts with place_role, R87); USD amounts in cents like C0 (decision 8)

now.description: what the worker does now, display text from ids

card_visibility.description: card per place opt-in; off (workspace only) by default in public places

events_30d.description: W21 only: events this worker wrote in the place in the last 30 days
events this person wrote in the place in the last 30 days (SPEC-WEB-UX 3.4.5)

reviews_30d.description: review decisions this person made in the place in the last 30 days

knowledge_states.description: C0 2.0 (C line): how many items of the vault (every W12 node) are in each knowledge state, by the W12 `knowledge_state` rule; `to_verify` counts the `outdated` ones whose own code anchor changed or is gone; null for sealed vaults

evidenced_pct.description: exact share in percent; null for sealed vaults

stale_pct.description: exact share in percent; null for sealed vaults

contradicted_pct.description: exact share in percent; null for sealed vaults

unconfirmed_pct.description: exact share in percent; null for sealed vaults

w36_message.description: W36 message: the C0 §3.19 message (ms times, like E16), sealed bodies omitted, worker senders with place_role; a purged message keeps only ids and purge {reason, at}

w36_messages.description: W36 GET …/messages?tail=&before_seq=&after_seq=: last_seq = the highest seq of the bus visible to the reader (for after_seq paging); next_before only when older messages exist (for before_seq paging)

w67_response.description: W67 GET /api/v1/orgs/{o}/fleet/collaboration?days=1..90&place= (R128): per-day counts from collab_daily; gate_reruns counts as friction

retention_rows.description: each subject at most once (else 400 invalid_body field: rows; checked by the server and the gate)

w29_request.description: W29 PUT …/vaults/{r}/retention (owner, H): government workspaces only (403 retention_not_allowed); the change takes effect after 7 days

w19_response.description: W19 POST …/vaults/{r}/revert/preview: the affected events (and derived nodes); sealed vaults: no statement

w20_request.description: W20 POST …/vaults/{r}/revert (H): one batch of system events, actor {kind: person, user_id}, cause {kind: revert, id: preview_id}; no revert_of member (decision B)

rev.description: seq of the last event of the revert batch

me_response.description: GET /api/v1/me: the signed-in person, their workspaces and the CSRF tag; `user.handle` is the public handle (null until set)

w25_request.description: W25 PATCH /api/v1/orgs/{o}/vaults/{r} (maintainer; sealed/license/presence/reviewer source: owner). Human-only + step-up when the body holds sealed, sealed_grants, reviewer_source, reviewer_usd_per_day or presence_public (R40, R81); sealed is turn-on only (R85).

w25_response.description: W25 answer = the W9 v4 vault

w26_request.description: W26 POST /api/v1/orgs/{o}/vaults/{r}/visibility (owner, class F, R80): to public needs a verified forge binding (409 forge_unverified), sealed=false (409 sealed_public_conflict) and the workspace policy allow_public_vaults (403 forbidden reason: policy); to internal needs Team or Enterprise (402 plan_required feature: internal_vaults)

w26_response.description: W26 answer = the W9 v4 vault

w27_request.description: W27 POST /api/v1/orgs/{o}/vaults/{r}/forge/verify (owner; 30 per user and 15 min; SPEC-CONTRACT-SERVER 3.23.2, R106): binds the vault to host/repo and checks the proof. token: the file .lean-ctx-hive-verify with the vault's token at the root of the default branch; dns: TXT _leanctx-hive.<domain> = leanctx-hive-verify=<token>, domain = host or a parent of it. Any other method: 400 invalid_body field: method. A new host or repo starts a new binding with a new token.

w27_request_refused.description: W27 request whose method is refused (400 invalid_body field: method): app, oauth and every other value

w27_response.description: W27 answer: the binding's state after this check; token (32 hex) while the binding is not verified, so the owner can place it

public_vaults.description: W44 GET /api/v1/public/vaults?q=&sort=stars|updated&license=&cursor= (no session; 600/min per IP, search 30/min per IP, R86): public vaults only, 30 per page; sealed vaults are never public

updated_at.description: ms of the vault's last event

public_vault.description: W44 GET /api/v1/public/vaults/{ws}/{r}: the header of a public vault; viewer only with a session (starred, following)

frozen.description: read-only until the owner verifies again

public_nodes.description: W44 …/nodes: the W12 list in public rendering (reviewed_by on every node; header X-Hive-Unreviewed)

public_node.description: W44 …/nodes/{id}: the W14 node in public rendering

public_graph.description: W44 …/graph?focus=&hops=2&max=300: the W13 graph in public rendering

public_history.description: W44 …/history: the vault's logbook lines (the W3 shape, handles only)

public_contributors.description: W44 …/contributors: W21 with handles only; workers (place_role, ids of at least 12 characters, R87) only when presence_public

items.description: the page items as written (E46/W58): a node reference or prose

public_health.description: W44 …/health: the W24 figures for readers, without blocked_reviews and capture_gate (R86)

evidenced_pct.description: exact share in percent; null for sealed vaults

stale_pct.description: exact share in percent; null for sealed vaults

contradicted_pct.description: exact share in percent; null for sealed vaults

unconfirmed_pct.description: exact share in percent; null for sealed vaults

public_bus_messages.description: W44 …/bus/messages: the W36 messages of the public vault bus (always readable, CONCEPT 6); foreign sender bodies fenced

w46_star.description: W46 PUT|DELETE /api/v1/public/vaults/{ws}/{r}/star (session; 120 per user per 15 min)

w46_follow.description: W46 PUT|DELETE …/follow (session; 120 per user per 15 min); a follow gets logbook lines in the follower's home

w46_report_request.description: W46 POST …/report (R86): with a session any reason (20 per user per 15 min); without one only reason illegal (EU DSA Art. 16 notice, 5 per hour per IP) with contact_email and good_faith: true; other reasons without a session 401 unauthorized

w46_report_response.description: W46 report answer; a receipt mail goes to the reporter

w63_response.description: W63 GET /api/v1/moderation/reports?state=open|actioned|void&cursor= (a Thinkery moderator; 300 per user per 15 min): every report target kind, 50 per page; signed-out DSA notices carry their unsealed contact (moderators only, R86)

w64_request.description: W64 POST /api/v1/orgs/{o}/vaults/{r}/purges/{id}/appeal (the vault's owner, class H, 10 per user): only for an illegal_content purge of this vault, one per purge

w39_list_response.description: W39 GET /swarms?tab=: the viewer's workspaces' swarms and the swarms it is invited to (no public tab, R107)

w39_create_request.description: W39 POST /swarms (team swarms only; coordinator null until the owner's first worker plans, R88)

w39_tree_response.description: W39 tree: 100 goal nodes per page under `parent`

w40_request.description: W40 PATCH /swarms/{id}: state (running from paused and archived are human-only) and settings (no visibility, no isolation)

w42_request.description: W42 PUT /swarms/{id}/pledge: the six fields; a loosening adds totp_code (class F)

swarm_workspace.description: the swarm's owning workspace (slug and display name)

w39_list_row.description: W39 list row (SPEC-WEB-UX §3.7): the swarm, its owning workspace, active participants, today's capacity (tasks pledged per day by the participants / claims started today), progress over the subgoals (done / not dropped) and, on the Mine tab, the viewer's open invite (badge Invited with Join and Decline)

my_swarm_invite.description: an open invite of the viewer (W66 GET /me/swarm-invites): the swarm it opens and who invited

w66_mine_response.description: W66 GET /api/v1/me/swarm-invites: the viewer's open, unexpired invites, newest first

w68_response.description: W68 GET /api/v1/orgs/{o}/knowledge/reuse?weeks=1..26 (v5 2.2.2, 2.6.1, plan v1.1 §5.3): per ISO week two separate figures, both derived on the server, never from engine telemetry. delivery: the server served engine B (E4 tail or E3 segment, first time per node and engine) a knowledge node another engine A wrote; it says the knowledge arrived, not that it was used. reuse: verified cross-engine reuse, only with a usage reference: B's own claim names A's node (node:<id> in its signed body) and B linked it with a live derived_from, references or depends_on edge, in a non-sealed vault; links without that citation never count. Oldest week first, the current ISO week last; evidence lists the newest usage references of the range

pairs.description: distinct (node, receiving engine) pairs first delivered this week: the Home headline

nodes.description: distinct nodes delivered to another engine

pairs.description: distinct (node, using engine) pairs with a usage reference this week; shown only when > 0

verified_knowledge_pairs.description: the pairs whose used node's knowledge_state is verified now

evidence.description: the newest usage references of the whole range, newest first: ids, workers and a time, never text

cited_by.description: engine B's claim that names it

vault.description: the vault the use lives in, for the node link: the caller's workspace slug and the vault name

at.description: when the server received the edge

w97_response.description: W97 GET /api/v1/orgs/{o}/knowledge/flow?days=1..180 (the overview of all workspaces, /app/): the workspace's knowledge flow per UTC day, oldest first, today (UTC) last. captured: knowledge nodes the workspace's engines added that day; delivered: W68's delivery (first deliveries of a node to another engine) of that day; reused: W68's verified reuse, distinct (node, engine B) pairs whose usage-reference edge arrived that day. Derived on the server, never from engine telemetry; counts only, no names

from.description: the first UTC day of the range

to.description: the last UTC day of the range (today), inclusive

captured.description: knowledge nodes (fact, decision, gotcha, procedure, finding, reference) added that day

delivered.description: first deliveries (node, receiving engine) of that day

reused.description: distinct verified-reuse pairs (node, using engine) of that day

policy_document.description: PolicyDocument (docs/API.md §7.1): one saved version of a scope's document; document null = removed at this version

hash.description: K22: this version's link in the scope's hash chain (sha256 hex); verify with …/history/verify

reason.description: K22: why a rule got looser (required on a loosening)

policy_field.description: one member of the policy table: merge rule and who enforces it (x-merge, x-enforcement, x-engine, x-server)

w77_response.description: W77 GET /api/v1/orgs/{o}/policies (reader): current documents (org -> engine, removed scopes left out) and the member table

w78_response.description: W78 GET /api/v1/orgs/{o}/policies/effective?instance= (own engine, admin): what that engine gets now; 409 non_mergeable with field

w79_response.description: W79 GET /api/v1/orgs/{o}/policies/enforcement (reader: own engines; admin: all): acked / refused / outdated / unreachable per live engine; acked.unenforced lists only engine-enforced members

w79_refusal.description: the engine's last refusal of a bundle issued to it (POST /v1/policy/ack with `refused`); cleared once it applies that version or a newer one

w80_request.description: W80 PUT /api/v1/orgs/{o}/policies/{level} (org, workspace: admin) and …/{level}/{scope} (vault: maintainer; engine: its owner or admin), class H0; loosening and org-level changes need step-up

expected_version.description: the scope's current version, 0 for none

reason.description: K22: why a rule gets looser; a loosening without it is 422 reason_required

w81_response.description: W81 DELETE …/policies/{level}[/{scope}]?expected_version= (roles as W80, class H0, step-up: a removal loosens): the removal version, document null

w82_response.description: W82 GET …/policies/{level}[/{scope}]/history (reader): versions newest first, at most 100

w83_response.description: W83 GET /api/v1/organisations/{g}/policies (organisation member): the organisation's current org-level document (scope orgn_…, none when removed) and the member table; it is the org level of every linked workspace

w84_request.description: W84 PUT /api/v1/organisations/{g}/policies/org (organisation admin, class H with step-up); 409 non_mergeable when it does not merge in some linked workspace

w84_response.description: W84 201: the saved version, level org, scope orgn_…

w85_response.description: W85 DELETE /api/v1/organisations/{g}/policies/org?expected_version= (organisation admin, class H with step-up): the removal version, document null

w86_response.description: W86 GET /api/v1/organisations/{g}/policies/org/history (organisation member): versions newest first, at most 100

w87_workspaces_linked.description: W87 DELETE /api/v1/organisations/{g} (organisation owner, class H with step-up): 204 without a body once no workspace is linked, else this 409 (workspaces = how many are still linked); the directory and the org-level policy go with it, the audit chain stays

w69_organisation.description: W69 a company (the B-line organisation, API.md §2.5) as seen by the caller: `teams` (= `workspaces`, kept) and its Business `plan` (null while none was granted)

w70_member.description: W70 directory entry: organisation role and the person's linked-workspace roles; email for admins and oneself

w71_workspace.description: W71 workspace linked to an organisation (plan = the effective one)

w71_link_request.description: W71 link an existing team workspace the caller owns, or create one under the organisation

w73_engine.description: W73 engine of a linked workspace with its POLICY-B1 enforcement state (null once revoked)

instance_ids.description: dashed UUID or wire id inst_<32 hex>, both forms accepted

w75_response.description: W75 GET /api/v1/organisations/{g}/activity/{view} and W76 GET /api/v1/orgs/{o}/activity/{view}: paged oversight, no message bodies

w88_response.description: W88 GET /api/v1/orgs/{o}/compute/jobs?state=&limit= (reader): compute jobs newest first (Release C)

w89_response.description: W89 GET /api/v1/orgs/{o}/compute/jobs/{job_id} (reader): the job and its result for the web; result is null while the job is queued or running and when it never ran (isolation_refused). No artifact or log bytes: engines fetch those with E52

w89_result.description: The stored result (compute.schema.json#/$defs/result: exit code, summary, artifact names, sizes and digests, the logs reference) and the end of the screened logs. After the retention (job.result_available false) the names stay and logs_tail is null

logs_tail.description: the last 8 KiB (at most 8192 bytes, cut at a character) of the stored logs, screened before storage like them; null without logs or once they are deleted

w90_response.description: W90 POST /api/v1/orgs/{o}/compute/jobs/{job_id}/cancel (contributor): a queued job ends at once with its reserve refunded; a running one is stopped and charged for the time it ran

w92_request.description: W92 POST /api/v1/orgs/{o}/compute/credit/top-up (owner, human session, step-up; test-mode Stripe only)

w92_response.description: W92: the test-mode Stripe Checkout to open

w94_request.description: W94 PUT /api/v1/orgs/{o}/compute/caps (admin, human session; raising a cap needs step-up)

w94_response.description: W94: the caps now in force

w95_response.description: W95 GET /api/v1/orgs/{o}/metrics/pilot?weeks=1..26 (admin; Release B commercial gate, CHECKLIST 3.4, plan v1.1 §8.4, §15): a workspace's pilot metrics from the server's own records, never engine telemetry: time to the first and second engine, vaults with active sync, engines on the current policy, per ISO week (oldest first) W68 delivery and reuse, reuse no longer current, coordination and policy-admin counts, and resource usage (bytes per vault, metered transfer and bus messages of the previous and current UTC month). Unit costs and margins are the operator's and never part of this response

to.description: the end of the current ISO week

first_engine_at.description: first token of the workspace's first engine (revoked ones count)

active.description: vaults an engine pushed into or read the snapshot/tail of within `days`

reuse.description: W68 verified cross-engine reuse of this week

reuse_not_current.description: of this week's reuse pairs, those whose used node is outdated, conflicting or rejected NOW (state at read time)

claims.description: task claims granted (vault_events task.claimed; a renewal is no claim)

refused_held.description: claims refused because another agent held the task: a double execution the claim prevented

refused_role.description: claims refused because the agent had not announced the task's role

lapsed.description: claims whose lease expired before a result

time_to_first_claim_p50_s.description: median seconds from a task's opening to its first claim, for first claims this week

saves.description: policy document versions saved in the workspace (org, workspace, vault, engine level)

loosenings.description: versions less strict than the version before them in any member (a removal of a non-empty document counts)

storage_bytes.description: the metered hot + cold bytes (storage_usage, hourly)

w96_instance.description: W96 engine of the workspace (API.md §3 Instance). slot_free_at: when a revoked engine's registered slot frees (Pro: revoked_at + 7 days, the cool-down); null while it is enrolled, once its slot is free (cool-down over or recovered, P7) and on every other plan

w96_response.description: W96 GET /api/v1/orgs/{o}/instances?state=connected|offline|revoked|all (reader: own engines, admin: all; ≤ 500, not revoked first)

w69_company_plan.description: The company's Business contract (0073): name, status, contract seats and the seats in use across its teams

w69_request_request.description: POST /api/v1/companies/requests: ask for a company on Business (on request; the operator grants it)

w69_billing_response.description: GET /api/v1/companies/{g}/billing (company admin): the Business contract, the pooled usage (Billing.usage of a team: every quota is the company's, counted across its teams; null without a contract in force or without teams), each team's share; changes go through us
